p: the shepherds that destroy and scatter: Meaning the prince's governors and false prophets as in Eze 34:2.
sheep of my pasture: For which I have special care, and have prepared good pastures for them.
feed my people: Whose charge is to feed the flock but they eat the fruit of it, Eze 34:3.

remnant of my flock from all: Thus the prophets always used to mix the promises with the threatenings lest the godly should be too much beaten down and therefore he shows how God will gather his Church after this dispersion.
Branch: This prophecy is of the restitution of the Church in the time of Jesus Christ, who is the true branch, read Isa 11:1,45:8, Jer 35:15, Da 9:24.
LORD liveth: Read Jer 16:14.
prophets: Meaning, the false prophets who deceive the people: in which appears his great love toward his nation, read Jer 14:13.
course is evil: They run headlong to wickedness and seek vain help.
house have I found their wickedness: My temple is full of their idolatry and superstitions.
an horrible thing: They who should have profited by my rods against Samaria, are become worse than they.
to me as Sodom: Though to the world they seem holy fathers, yet I detest them as I did these abominable cities.
wormwood: Read Jer 8:14.
heart: Which they have invented of their own brain.
shall have peace: Read Jer 6:14,8:11.
who hath stood in the counsel: Thus they derided Jeremiah as though the word of God was not revealed to him, so also spoke Zedekiah to Micaiah, 1Ki 22:24.
shall consider it perfectly: Both that God has sent me, and that my words will be true.
had caused my people to hear: He shows the difference between the true prophets and the false, between the hireling and the true minister.
afar off: Do I not see your falsehood, however you cloak it, and wherever you commit it?
have dreamed: I have a prophecy revealed to me as in Nu 12:6.
my people to forget my name: He shows that Satan raises up false prophets to bring the people from God.
tell a dream: Let the false prophet declare that it is his own fantasy, and not slander my word as though it were a cloak to cover his lies.

What is the chaff to the: Meaning, that it is not enough for God's ministers to abstain from lies and to speak the word of God but that there is judgment in alleging it, and that it may appear to be applied to the same purpose that it was spoken, Eze 3:27, 1Co 2:13,4:2, 2Ti 2:25.
steal my words every one from: Who set forth in my Name that which I have not commanded.
He saith: That is, the Lord.

burden of the LORD: The prophets called their threatenings God's burden, which the sinners were not able to sustain, therefore the wicked in deriding the word, would ask of the prophets, what was the burden as though they would say, "You seek nothing else, but to lay burdens on our shoulders" and thus they rejected the word of God as a grievous burden.

burden of the LORD: Because this word was brought to contempt and derision, he will teach them another manner of speech, and will cause this word burden to cease and teach them to ask with reverence, "What says the Lord?"
word shall be his burden: The thing which they mock and contemn will come on them.
